entries.headline: Elon Musk's AI can now log into your accounts and work
entries.what_happened: xAI launched Grok Bot, an AI agent that can sign into your apps and websites and complete multi-step tasks for you, like a virtual coworker.
entries.why_it_matters: AI agents that log into systems on a person's behalf are exactly the kind of access risk your company's identity and access management products exist to control, so this is a live example of the problem you're selling a solution for.

new_terms.definition: Software that can take actions and complete tasks on its own, not just answer questions like a chatbot.

entries.headline: New startup builds a control system for company AI agents
entries.what_happened: Cohesor launched a product that acts as a central hub to manage and oversee AI agents that businesses use across their systems.
entries.why_it_matters: This is essentially a new entrant in the same space your startup operates in — managing what AI agents are allowed to do — so it's worth knowing about for competitive awareness.

new_terms.definition: A central system used to manage, monitor, and control other systems or software — here, AI agents.

entries.headline: OpenAI says businesses now let AI do the work, not just help
entries.what_happened: OpenAI released research showing companies are shifting from using AI as an assistant to letting it independently execute tasks, and identified which businesses are adopting this fastest.
entries.why_it_matters: As more companies let AI agents act on their own, they'll need stronger ways to control what those agents can access — directly increasing demand for the kind of product your startup builds.

new_terms.definition: AI that can take multi-step actions and complete tasks on its own, rather than just responding to questions.

entries.headline: Companies are struggling to price and budget for AI
entries.what_happened: Businesses buying AI tools are finding it hard to predict and control what they'll be charged, and the AI companies selling these tools aren't sure how to price them either.
entries.why_it_matters: Understanding how AI vendors charge for usage will help you evaluate tools your startup buys, and think through pricing if you ever build AI features into your own product.

new_terms.definition: How AI companies price their services, usually based on 'tokens' — small chunks of text the AI processes.
